Bill.BriefDescription: Including pharmacies in robbery in the first degree provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to committing a robbery within and against apharmacy; amending RCW 9A.56.200; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.56.200 and 2002 c 85 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of robbery in the first degree if: (a) In the commission of a robbery or of immediate flighttherefrom, he or she: (i) Is armed with a deadly weapon; or (ii) Displays what appears to be a firearm or other deadly weapon;or (iii) Inflicts bodily injury; ((or)) (b) He or she commits a robbery within and against a financialinstitution as defined in RCW 7.88.010 or 35.38.060; or (c) He or she commits a robbery against a pharmacy, by taking anysubstance that may be obtained only from a licensed pharmacist. (2) For the purposes of this section, "pharmacy" has the same p. 1 SSB 6498meaning as defined in RCW 18.64.011. (3) Robbery in the first degree is a class A felony.
